speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I heard the bells. That's all I know of it, and all I'll say I know.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Five. I haven't a name for one of them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They wanted butter at threepence. Then a pillory down. And a court has called it war upon the Queen.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A fortnight since, a gentleman at Clerkenwell told me nobody is to see a king put from his chair. Not in a play. I said yes, sir.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have a prince in the new one who says the next man that draws shall die for it. I wrote that on a Saturday and thought it only a line.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Five 'prentices nobody will ever put in a chronicle.
